value.rationale: There is a natural qualitative mismatch between distances in a sparse-cut shuffle: every transition has an n-uniform regeneration component and TV mixing is bounded, yet the chi-square time diverges at the sharp rate log(n)/(2c). The explicit integer-time profile and uniformity over initial cards resolve the metric-level transition at the precise cut sparsity scale, beyond merely restating finite spectral eigenvalues.
